case_title.quote: DANDU JAGGARAJU v. STATE OF A.P.

number_of_accused.reason: Only one appellant is tried and decided.

accused_gender.quote: killed his niece on account of family honour
accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as male (the paternal uncle, 'his').

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is given.

accused_caste.reason: The accused's caste is never named; only the victim is called Kshatriya.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Nothing on the accused's wealth or class.

victim_caste.quote: The deceased Varalakshmi who was a Kshatriya had married P.W. 1, a member of the Scheduled Castes

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the appellant who was the paternal uncle of the deceased

statutory_provisions.quote: Section 302, 201 and 379 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: died of asphyxia due to smothering as her chunni had been thrust into her mouth
weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned; the cause of death is accurately described.

evidence_type.quote: last seen evidence ... the medical evidence and the recoveries
evidence_type.reason: These are the evidence types relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating facts are noted; the motive was doubted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted him of the offences charged and sentenced him accordingly

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court has, in appeal, confirmed the judgment of conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: allow the appeal and order the appellant's acquittal

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate to the judgment, anonymised, and does not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment states no punishment prescribed.

physical_harm.quote: died of asphyxia due to smothering

financial_property_loss.quote: 'disco jewellery' and is commonly available to all and sundry

premeditation_planning.quote: taken away under a pretext by the appellant
premeditation_planning.reason: Only alleged by the prosecution, not found by the Court.

motive.reason: Alleged motive was doubted by the Court.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: This circumstance, therefore, does not even remotely support the prosecution story
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court accepted no evidence linking the accused.

witness_credibility.quote: last seen evidence of P.Ws. 2, 3 and 6 is equally uncertain

post_offence_conduct.quote: completely unacceptable that ... the appellant had continued to move around with the jewellery

custody_duration.quote: We are told that he is in custody.
custody_duration.reason: Arrest on 7 September 2002 and present custody are stated.

trial_duration.reason: Dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Siddharth Dave, Jemtiben Ao for the Appellant. D. Mahesh Babu, Ramesh Allanki, Savita Dhanda for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: On the completion of the investigation, the appellant was brought to trial

procedural_irregularity.quote: no effort had been made to hold a test identification parade

appeal_history.quote: allow the appeal and order the appellant's acquittal

prosecution_argument.quote: the last seen evidence and the recoveries by themselves did constitute such a chain

defence_argument.quote: there was absolutely no evidence to connect the appellant to the crime
